en.html:
Ichijou"N-no, please, it's nothing like that..."
Sayo"The fault is ours, for not minding our manners and agitating you. For this Sayo to be so careless is unforgivable, and no word of apology is enough. Today will be made up for, without fail, in due course..."
Kageaki"Please, let there be no such thought. ...Especially you, Ayane."
Ichijou"Y-yes?"
Kageaki"Earlier I lost control and then, I think, poured out words no one should have to hear. It was rude beyond limit. I have no face to show."
Ichijou"N-no! You did nothing wrong, Minato sir. It was me, I kept saying thoughtless things when I did not understand anything..."
Ichijou"I'm really sorry!"
Kageaki"Thank you for your consideration. Now, this is not meant to replace an apology, but"
Ichijou"Yes...?"
Kageaki"Your earlier request—I should like to consider it. The terms, however, could not honestly be called favorable."
Ichijou"Eh...? R-really!?"
Kageaki"Before that, I must say this once more. Involvement with me is dangerous."
Kageaki"It is truly dangerous・・・・・・・・・. It threatens life."
Kageaki"The same applies to you, Captain."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"My recommendation to both of you is to go home now, without hearing anything further. That is without doubt the best course."
Kageaki"If you remain nevertheless, forgive me: the choice is a very foolish one. Needless danger, entered voluntarily. No other description is available to me."
Kageaki"So I will say it plainly. I have no strict need of anyone'sanyone assistance."
Kanae"............"
Ichijou"............"
Kageaki"With all of that understood, please reconsider. Can you not simply go home?"

en.html:
Kanae"I hardly need to answer, do I?"
Kageaki"Captain..."
Kanae"My cooperation with you was assigned to me as a GHQ officer, Mr. Kageaki. It does not reverse just because you have taken a dislike to me. And besides—"
Kanae"Pride I have also. 'Not needed,' and then I quietly leave? That would disgrace the Ootori name. I shall have that statement withdrawn. Kindly look forward to it."
Sayo"That is exactly like you, Miss."
Kageaki"..."
Ichijou"...Me too. Sorry, Minato sir."
Ichijou"I know I will be trouble. I know the things I did against street thugs will not work on your enemies. I do understand that."
Ichijou"But I want to become someone who can fight! Even if I cannot now, one day, for sure. I do not want to run away from the things I cannot forgive. Rokuhara or Silver Star, I do not care which."
Ichijou"I do not want to live in a way that would shame the person who raised me. I want to learn how to fight. So... please! Keep me beside you, Minato sir!"
Kageaki"............"
Kanae"...Is it my imagination, or did her appeal make a considerably better impression than mine?"
Sayo"Such earnest determination. You have been quite outdone, Miss."
Ichijou"STOP HECKLING!! D-determination? I-I only meant—"

en.html:
I stop there for a moment. Nobody makes a sound.

Their faces differ little: each has thoughts, none has words.

That reaction suits my cowardly calculation very well. A bare list of the minimum facts, and I am spared everything else.

—Everything else?

No. Under any honest accounting, it is the very thing I must explain before all others: <ruby>why<rt>・・</rt></ruby> she went mad.

But I cannot possibly tell it. If they learned that the same <ruby>curse<rt>・・</rt></ruby> clings to me, they would loathe me and go, which alone would be welcome, and then, each in her own way, they would blow the whistle on my sin.

Not yet. Until Silver Star is wiped from this world, I must stay free to move as necessity demands. The hour of judgment has not come.

...That it is I who decide this is arrogance of the highest order. I know it.

So I keep my mouth shut on that point and carry the explanation on, helped by their silence, which they probably mean as consideration.

Despicable, entirely.

But I cannot possibly tell it. If they learned that the same curse・・ clings to me, they would loathe me and go, which alone would be welcome, and then, each in her own way, they would blow the whistle on my sin.

Not yet. Until Silver Star is wiped from this world, I must stay free to move as necessity demands. The hour of judgment has not come.

...That it is I who decide this is arrogance of the highest order. I know it.

So I keep my mouth shut on that point and carry the explanation on, helped by their silence, which they probably mean as consideration.

Despicable, entirely.

一度、口を切る。
　声を発する者はいない。

　表情は大同小異だった。
　思うところはあるが、言葉を見つけられない。そう
いう顔。

　その反応は俺の卑劣な計算を満足させるに足りた。
　最低限度の事実の羅列のみで、余計なことを話さず
に済む。

　――余計？
　
　否。本来なら、何を置いても話さねばならないこと
だろう。あれが<ruby>なぜ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>狂ったのか、は。

　だが話せる筈もなかった。
　その<ruby>呪い<rt>・・</rt></ruby>が俺にも纏わりついていることを知れば、
彼女らは俺を忌み、離れ――それだけなら望ましいが
――それぞれのやり方で俺の罪を鳴らすだろう。

　今はまだ、困る。
『銀星号』をこの世から抹消するまでは、俺は必要に
応じて自由に動ける身でなくてはならない。

　まだ、裁きの時ではない。
　……それを俺が決めること自体、傲慢を極めている
が。

　俺はその点について全く口を噤んだまま、説明を次
へ移した。おそらくはこちらを気遣ってだろう、周囲
が沈黙しているのを利して。
　何とも卑劣に。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Why is Silver Star so terrible? Why does the slaughter go on at a scale no single warrior should be able to produce? There is a reason."
Kageaki"First, straightforward fighting ability. Sword-armor, pilot: for either, I know of no better."
Sayo"I would say you are rather formidable yourself, Mr. Minato. And still, more than that...?"
Kageaki"Ji. To put it modestly, her talent has one extra zero."
Ichijou"............"
Kageaki"The other ability is more serious. That sword-armor can contaminate the mind."
Kanae"...Mental contamination?"
Sayo"What a very inauspicious phrase."
Kageaki"In practice it is more inauspicious still. Silver Star radiates, in a wide circle around itself, a peculiar gravitational wave that acts on brain activity: a contamination wavepheromone."
Kageaki"Anyone who receives the wave becomes synchronized in mind with Silver Star. ...With the mind of a deranged murderer."
Ichijou"...Oh. Then the Silver Star incidents, the victims・・・, the bodies that look exactly as if they killed each other・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・—is that how?"
Kageaki"Correct. Most victims in those incidents were made to kill one another, their minds taken over by Silver Star."
Sayo"Good heavens..."
Kanae"What a thoroughly nasty piece of work."
Kageaki"Indeed. And worse still, if a warrior makes contact with Silver Star—"
Ichijou"The warrior gets contaminated too?"
Kageaki"No. Even those waves appear unable to breach the steel wall of sword-armor and affect the warrior within. At least, I know of no such case."
Kageaki"But Silver Star can plant an 'egg' in a warrior."
Kanae"An egg?"
Kageaki"'Egg' is a name of convenience. These too appear to be a kind of contamination wave. Those I have seen were spheres of light: contact with sword-armor, absorption, then growth within."
Kageaki"After an unspecified period, it hatches・・."
Kanae"...And what happens then?"
Kageaki"That, I have never witnessed. Every egg Silver Star scattered has been destroyed by me before hatching. Most of these two years—one might say that was the work."
Kageaki"Their destruction may be more urgent even than subduing Silver Star. If the account I received is correct—if, at the instant of hatching, the infected warrior—"
Kageaki"becomes the same thing as Silver Star・・・・・・・・・・・."
Kanae"............"
Ichijou"............"
Sayo"...I see. Then 'egg' is exactly the right word."
Kageaki"This has not been made public. The people who know are the chief, myself, our patron His Highness of the Maidono, and now all of you."
Ichijou"We tell nobody. Obviously, right?"
Kageaki"That is my request. If the contamination wave and the eggs became talk across the city—"
Kanae"There would be panic. Silver Star would no longer be a mere monster: people would hear that coming near is enough to drive them mad, and that more such things may appear."
Sayo"A sure faint in every living room in the country."

景明 「……銀星号が何故かくも恐るべき存在なの か。ただ一騎の武者の為す事とは到底思えぬ までに殺戮を繰り広げられるのか。 　それには理由があります」
景明 「まず一つは単純な戦闘能力。 　劔冑もそれを操る仕手も、自分の知る限り では最上と言って良いでしょう」
さよ 「湊斗さまも相当なものとお見受けしますが。 　それよりも尚……？」
景明 「はい。 　控えめに評して、才能の桁が一つ違います」
一条 「…………」
景明 「そしてもう一つ……こちらの方が深刻です。 　あの劔冑は、精神汚染の能力を持ちます」
香奈枝 「……精神汚染？」
さよ 「なんとも不穏な響きでございますねぇ」
景明 「実際、不穏の極みでしょう。 　銀星号は自己を中心として円形状の広範囲 に、脳活動へ影響を及ぼす特異な重力波―― 汚染波フェロモンを放散します」
景明 「この汚染波を受けた人間は、銀星号と精神 を同調させます。 　……狂った殺人鬼の精神と、です」
一条 「……あっ。 　もしかしてあの、銀星号事件の――被害者・・・ 同士で殺し合ったようにしか見えない遺体・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・、 っていうのは」
景明 「その通りです。事件の被害者の多くは殺し 合わされたのです。 　心を銀星号に奪われて」
さよ 「なんとまぁ……」
香奈枝 「タチの悪い話ですこと」
景明 「全くに。 　そして更に一層悪質なのは、武者が銀星号 と接触してしまった場合――」
一条 「武者も汚染されるんですか？」
景明 「いえ。さしもの汚染波も甲鉄の壁を破って 武者を影響下に置く事はできないようです。 　少なくとも自分の知る限り、そうした事例 は有りません」
景明 「ですが…… 　銀星号は武者に対して〝卵〟を植え付ける ことができます」
香奈枝 「たまご？」
景明 「便宜上そう呼んでいますが、これもやはり 汚染波の一種ではあるようです。 　自分の知る〝卵〟は光球状で、劔冑と接触 すると吸収され、その内部で成長――」
景明 「不特定の期間を経て、孵化・・を迎えます」
香奈枝 「……すると、どうなるのでしょう？」
景明 「自分はまだ目撃したことがありません。 　銀星号が撒いた〝卵〟はすべて孵化の前に 破壊してきました。この二年間のほとんどは その作業に費やされたと言ってもいい」
景明 「あるいは銀星号の制圧以上に〝卵〟の破壊 は急務であったからです。 　自分の聞いた話が正しく……〝卵〟に寄生 された武者は、孵化を迎えたその刹那――」
景明 「銀星号と同じものになる・・・・・・・・・・・のなら」
香奈枝 「…………」
一条 「…………」
さよ 「……なるほど。 　まさに〝卵〟なのでございますね」
景明 「この話は公表されておりません。知る人間 は自分と署長、後援者であられる舞殿宮殿下。 　そして貴方がただけです」
一条 「他言無用……ですよね、もちろん」
景明 「左様に願います。 　汚染波や〝卵〟の話が市中に広まった場合 ――」
香奈枝 「パニックになりますね……。 　銀星号がただの化物ではなく、近寄られた だけで発狂させられるだとか、そんな代物が 更に増えるかも知れないだとか」
さよ 「お茶の間卒倒は間違い無しのネタでござい ます」
